title: Weakly-Coupled Multi-Action Restless Bandits -- Exponential Convergence in Probability
summary: We study a finite time horizon Markov decision process (MDP) consisting of several groups of multi-action finite-state restless bandit processes, which are identical within each group. The bandit processes into different groups can be rather different. The bandit processes are subject to multiple weakly coupled constraints on their state and action variables.
